page.overview:
Who is Bella Noche?

Cosmic Entity (possibly)}} Bella Noche is a being of pure anti-magic and the main antagonist of the episode "Betty". They exist in another dimension and have the power to remove other people's magic. Bella Noche can escape their dimension by using a unique staff (in this case, the Staff of Stranson Doughblow), a sword, an orb, and a goblet arranged within a circle drawn on the ground.

In the episode "Betty", Bella Noche tricked the Secret Society (Forest Wizard, Laser Wizard, and Bufo) into believing that if they used their magic to bring them to their world, then they would grant them a magical reward. After the group becomes distracted by Ice King, who revealed himself to have been spying, Bella Noche used the Staff of Stranson Doughblow to come into their dimension, presenting themself as a humanoid in a black cube that absorbed all magic around it. The Grand Master Wizard arrived and tried to have his guards destroy the being with their shoes, but it was ineffective.

By the end of the episode, Bella Noche had taken over the entirety of Wizard City, becoming a massive mountain made out of black cubes. As the remaining wizards tried futilely to defeat him, Betty arrived and made her way into the center of the cubes, where Bella Noche resided. She immediately kicked Bella Noche, defeating them and ending their reign of terror.

Bella Noche's most notable ability is to use their anti-magic powers to take magical powers away from wizards. Once they absorb their magic, which is done either from being hit by the shock wave that summoned or by touching their black goo-like substance, they are able to fight off their attackers by using tentacle-like appendages that distend from the side of their black cube-like forcefield, which becomes bigger as they absorb more magic (or by accidentally being amplified as it was with a spell during the episode).
